comisiones.querySql: SELECT CAST(TRIM(A.cnpoliza) AS varchar(30)) AS numero_poliza, CAST(A.cramo AS int) AS id_ramo, CAST(TRIM(B.xdescripcion_l) AS varchar(100)) AS ramo, CAST(ISNULL(TRIM(E.cid), '') AS varchar(30)) AS cedula_tomador, CAST(ISNULL(TRIM(E.xcliente), '') AS varchar(240)) AS nombre_tomador, CAST(ISNULL(TRIM(C.cid), '') AS varchar(30)) AS cedula_asegurado, CAST(ISNULL(TRIM(C.xcliente), '') AS varchar(240)) AS nombre_asegurado, CAST(TRIM(A.cnrecibo) AS varchar(30)) AS numero_recibo, CAST(A.femision AS datetime) AS fecha_emision_recibo, CAST(A.fdesde AS datetime) AS fecha_desde_recibo, CAST(A.fhasta AS datetime) AS fecha_hasta_recibo, CAST(ISNULL(A.iestadorec, '') AS varchar(10)) AS estado_recibo, CAST(CASE WHEN A.iestadorec = 'P' THEN 'Pendiente' WHEN A.iestadorec = 'C' THEN 'Cobrado' WHEN A.iestadorec = 'A' THEN 'Anulado' WHEN A.iestadorec = 'N' THEN 'Notificado' WHEN A.iestadorec = 'S' THEN 'Suspendido' ELSE A.iestadorec END AS varchar(30)) AS estado_recibo_desc, CAST(ISNULL(DATEDIFF(DAY, A.fdesde, A.fhasta), 0) AS int) AS dias_vigencia, CAST(A.fcobro AS datetime) AS fecha_cobro_recibo, CAST(ISNULL(A.cdoccob, 0) AS int) AS numero_ingreso, CAST(TRIM(F.cmoneda) AS varchar(10)) AS moneda_recibo, CAST(ISNULL(A.msumabruta, 0) AS numeric(17, 4)) AS suma_asegurada, CAST(ISNULL(A.msumabrutaext, 0) AS numeric(17, 4)) AS suma_asegurada_ext, CAST(ISNULL(A.mprimabruta, 0) AS numeric(17, 4)) AS monto_recibo_bruto, CAST(ISNULL(A.mprimabrutaext, 0) AS numeric(17, 4)) AS monto_recibo_bruto_ext, CAST(ISNULL(A.mpagado, 0) AS numeric(17, 4)) AS monto_recibo_pagado, CAST(ISNULL(A.mpagadoext, 0) AS numeric(17, 4)) AS monto_recibo_pagado_ext, CAST(ISNULL(G.csucur, 0) AS int) AS id_sucursal, CAST(TRIM(G.xdescripcion_l) AS varchar(100)) AS sucursal, CAST(ISNULL(A.cproductor, 0) AS int) AS id_productor, CAST(TRIM(H.xproductor) AS varchar(150)) AS productor, CAST(ISNULL(TRIM(prod_cli.cid), '') AS varchar(30)) AS cedula_productor, CAST(ISNULL(prod_cli.ipersona, '') AS varchar(10)) AS tipo_persona_productor, CAST(ISNULL(M.imovcom, '') AS varchar(10)) AS tipo_movimiento_codigo, CAST(CASE WHEN M.imovcom = 'BO' THEN TRIM(O.xbono) WHEN M.imovcom = 'CO' THEN 'Comision' WHEN M.imovcom = 'GR' THEN 'Gastos Ramo' ELSE M.imovcom END AS varchar(50)) AS tipo_movimiento, CAST(ISNULL(CASE WHEN W.cmoneda = 'Bs  ' THEN M.mmovcom ELSE M.mmovcomext END, 0) AS numeric(17, 4)) AS monto_movimiento, CAST(ISNULL(M.mmovcom, 0) AS numeric(17, 4)) AS monto_movimiento_bs, CAST(ISNULL(M.mmovcomext, 0) AS numeric(17, 4)) AS monto_movimiento_ext, CAST(ISNULL(CASE WHEN M.imovcom = 'CO' THEN A.pcomision WHEN M.imovcom = 'BO' THEN O.pbono WHEN M.imovcom = 'GR' THEN M.pmovim END, 0) AS numeric(7, 4)) AS porcentaje_comision, CAST(ISNULL(W.pislr, 0) AS numeric(7, 4)) AS porcentaje_islr, CAST(ISNULL(CASE WHEN W.pislr > 0 THEN (CASE WHEN W.cmoneda = 'Bs  ' THEN M.mmovcom ELSE M.mmovcomext END) * W.pislr / 100 ELSE 0 END, 0) AS numeric(17, 4)) AS monto_islr, CAST(TRIM(M.cmoneda) AS varchar(10)) AS moneda_cobro, CAST(TRIM(W.cmoneda) AS varchar(10)) AS moneda_pago, CAST(ISNULL(M.ptasamon, 1) AS numeric(17, 4)) AS tasa_cobro, CAST(ISNULL(M.csolpag, 0) AS int) AS numero_orden_pago, CAST(ISNULL(BR.xbanco, '') AS varchar(100)) AS banco, CAST(ISNULL(Q.xreferencia_1, '') AS varchar(100)) AS referencia_bancaria, CAST(W.fmovim AS datetime) AS fecha_pago_comision, CAST(ISNULL(W.mmonto_4, 0) AS numeric(17, 4)) AS monto_sustraendo, CAST(ISNULL(W.mpagosol, 0) AS numeric(17, 4)) AS monto_neto_orden, CAST(ISNULL(W.mpago - W.mpagosol, 0) AS numeric(17, 4)) AS monto_islr_orden, CAST(ISNULL(W.mpago, 0) AS numeric(17, 4)) AS monto_bruto_orden, CAST(ISNULL(cob.coberturas, '') AS varchar(1000)) AS coberturas, COALESCE(M.fultmod, W.fmovim, A.fcobro, A.femision) AS modified_at FROM adrecibos A WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN maramos B WITH (NOLOCK) ON A.cramo = B.cramo LEFT JOIN maclient C WITH (NOLOCK) ON A.casegurado = C.cci_rif LEFT JOIN maclient E WITH (NOLOCK) ON A.ctenedor = E.cci_rif LEFT JOIN mamonedas F WITH (NOLOCK) ON A.cmoneda = F.cmoneda LEFT JOIN masucur G WITH (NOLOCK) ON A.csucur = G.csucur LEFT JOIN maproduc H WITH (NOLOCK) ON A.cproductor = H.cproductor LEFT JOIN maclient prod_cli WITH (NOLOCK) ON prod_cli.cci_rif = H.cci_rif INNER JOIN admovcom M WITH (NOLOCK) ON A.crecibo = M.ccodigo AND M.istatcon != 'N' LEFT JOIN adsolpg W WITH (NOLOCK) ON M.csolpag = W.csolpag OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 xbanco_1, xreferencia_1 FROM adsolpg_d WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE csolpag = M.csolpag ORDER BY id ASC) Q LEFT JOIN mabanco BR WITH (NOLOCK) ON BR.cbanco = Q.xbanco_1 OUTER APPLY (SELECT STRING_AGG(x.xdesc, ' / ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY x.xdesc) AS coberturas FROM (SELECT DISTINCT LTRIM(RTRIM(MCO.xdescripcion_l)) AS xdesc FROM adpolcob CO WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN macoberturas MCO WITH (NOLOCK) ON CO.ccober = MCO.ccobertura AND CO.cramo = MCO.cramo WHERE CO.crecibo = A.crecibo AND MCO.xdescripcion_l IS NOT NULL AND LTRIM(RTRIM(MCO.xdescripcion_l)) <> '') x) cob LEFT JOIN mabonos O WITH (NOLOCK) ON M.imovcom = 'BO' AND M.ccodmov = O.cbono AND O.iestado = 'v' AND A.cramo = O.cramo AND (M.cproductor = O.cproductor OR O.cproductor = 0) WHERE A.cproductor != 80080 AND ((A.iestadorec = 'C' AND A.cdoccob > 0) OR A.iestadorec IN ('A', 'P')) AND (@istatcom IS NULL OR M.istatcom = @istatcom) AND (@desde IS NULL OR /*SYNC_DATE_COL*/ >= CAST(@desde AS datetime)) AND (@hasta IS NULL OR /*SYNC_DATE_COL*/ <= CAST(@hasta AS datetime)) AND (@cproductor IS NULL OR A.cproductor = @cproductor) AND (@cmoneda IS NULL OR W.cmoneda = @cmoneda OR A.cmoneda = @cmoneda) AND (@poliza IS NULL OR A.cnpoliza = @poliza) AND (@recibo IS NULL OR A.cnrecibo = @recibo) /*SYNC_WHERE*/ /*SYNC_ORDER BY*/
